page_title: BOL 1-3 CRE | Bologna v Cremonese 01/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Ermano Feliciani has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bologna.
90+4' Bologna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+4' The resulting set piece from Bologna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Bologna win a corner kick.
90+2' That looked a certain handball by Francesco Folino (Cremonese) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
90+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bologna.
90+1' Bologna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball goes out of play and Bologna have been awarded a corner kick.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' A cross from a corner kick by Bologna is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
87' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the right post. Emil Audero is alert and denies him with a nice save.
86' Here comes a substitution. Francesco Folino (Cremonese) is brought on as a substitute for Giuseppe Pezzella.
85' Emil Holm (Bologna) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
83' Santiago Castro (Bologna) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Emil Audero.

82' What a chance that is! Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes high over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.

79' Unbelievable miss! Filippo Terracciano (Cremonese) reacts superbly to latch on to a rebound, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
79' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a change. Emil Holm (Bologna) replaces Nadir Zortea.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Riccardo Orsolini trots off the pitch and is replaced by Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna).
79' Cremonese will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

76' Santiago Castro (Bologna) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
76' Substitution. Warren Bondo makes his way off the pitch and Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) comes on as his replacement.
76' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) replacing Federico Bonazzoli.
75' Substitution. Jens Odgaard makes way for Thijs Dallinga (Bologna).
73' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bologna comes to nothing.
71' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety.
69' Bologna enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
66' The manager makes a subsitution with Alberto Grassi (Cremonese) coming on for Martin Payero.

65' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) leaps highest to meet the resulting corner and attempts to head home, but the effort goes harmlessly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
65' Bologna have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

65' Nadir Zortea (Bologna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bologna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
63' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
62' Martin Payero (Cremonese) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
60' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
59' Filippo Terracciano (Cremonese) has tested the patience of referee Ermano Feliciani and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
58' Corner kick falls to Jamie Vardy (Cremonese), who attempts to finish. Luck is not on his side today as the ball crashes against the right post.
58' Cremonese have been awarded a corner kick.
57' A corner kick by Cremonese is thwarted by the well prepared Federico Ravaglia (Bologna). Cremonese have been awarded a corner kick.
57' Cremonese failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Good work from Cremonese as they win a corner.
56' Cremonese win a corner.

55' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
53' Bologna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
50' 1 - 3 Goal! Tommaso Barbieri provides Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom right corner. 1:3.
49' A pass by Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is out of play. Cremonese will have a throw-in.
48' Cremonese couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Federico Ravaglia (Bologna) leaped high and intercepted the cross.

47' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Ermano Feliciani with no other option than to blow for a foul. It's a free kick to Cremonese in a dangerous position.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
46' Half-time substitution. Vincenzo Italiano decided to make a change. Nicolo Casale (Bologna) is replaced by Torbjorn Lysaker Heggem.
46' Half-time substitution. Benjamin Dominguez will not participate anymore and Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) is coming on.
45+4' Ermano Feliciani has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' 1 - 2 Goal! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Emil Audero into the bottom right corner.
45+3' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is going to take the penalty!
45+1' Matteo Bianchetti (Cremonese) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. It's a penalty for Bologna!
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Cremonese.
44' The ball is cleared after Warren Bondo (Cremonese) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Cremonese force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
42' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
40' The Bologna players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.

38' What an opportunity! Juan Miranda (Bologna) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
35' 0 - 2 Fantastic team goal! Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) was set free in the area by Federico Bonazzoli and fired low past Federico Ravaglia. 0:2.
33' 60:40 – the ratio of ball possession.

31' 0 - 1 Stunning strike! Martin Payero (Cremonese) latches on to a precise through ball from Matteo Bianchetti before unleashing an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 0:1.
29' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cremonese, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
28' Rough tackle by Tommaso Pobega (Bologna). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Cremonese are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
25' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) was quite harsh and Ermano Feliciani didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
24' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
21' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
21' Bologna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bologna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
20' Bologna take a short corner kick.

18' The ball rebounds to Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he bends the ball well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
17' The corner kick from Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
15' A pass from Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) is intercepted by Federico Ravaglia and the move breaks down.
12' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
12' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Cremonese will take a corner kick.
11' Juan Miranda (Bologna) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Emil Audero intercepts the ball.
8' A snap shot by Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Emil Audero produces a good save to thwart him.
6' Nadir Zortea (Bologna) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
5' Bologna seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
3' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball, though, only brushes the left post.

2' Warren Bondo (Cremonese) brings his opponent down. Ermano Feliciani has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Bologna will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Cremonese will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Ermano Feliciani.
